text:
Situation: Corvale Lakeside holds 15 tablets of sertraline hydrochloride 25 mg, providing 8.5 days of supply. Corvale East holds 208 tablets (31.1 days) and Corvale General holds 224 tablets (28.4 days). A transfer of 10 tablets from either site would bring Lakeside to approximately 14 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include sertraline hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21. The product label identifies Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc. as the repack plant (FEI 3004582966). FDA's most recent inspection of that plant ended 2025-05-27 and was classified VAI.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The issue is localized to Corvale Lakeside. Internal transfer is the fastest, lowest-risk option. Purchasing from alternate manufacturers is feasible but not urgent.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves transfer request for 10 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside.
2. If Corvale East cannot release stock, pharmacy director approves transfer request for 10 tablets of 25 mg from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside.
3. Buyer places purchase order with Accord Healthcare, Inc. if transfers are delayed.
4. Buyer places purchase order with Ascent Pharmaceuticals, Inc. if transfers are delayed.
5. Buyer places purchase order with Aurobindo Pharma Limited if transfers are delayed.

Not recommended: No action is discouraged at this time; all listed options remain viable.
